status: The single official Material-B neural-training rule; earlier fixed-budget and capped runs were validation-only pilots, not paper results.
timing: Frozen after inspecting validation-only pilot curves and before accessing reserved test or held-out path prediction labels. Applied identically to all five models and three seeds.
unchanged: Data split, FOM labels, selected feature table, architectures, initialization, objective, optimizer settings other than the Adam scheduler threshold, validation metric, and best-checkpoint selection are inherited from the frozen preparation recipe.
validation_metric: Mean squared normalized validation stress error divided by the frozen fit-stress denominator; evaluated every 10 Adam steps and after every LBFGS outer call. Lower is better. Strict minimum over initialization and both phases selects the final model.

adam.stop_rule: At a validation check, after the minimum step count, stop Adam only if the running best score has gained less than 0.1% cumulatively for 100 checks (1000 steps), the scheduler has reduced LR at least twice, and at least 40 checks have elapsed since the last reduction. If the review boundary arrives first, pause and retain exact current optimizer, scheduler, RNG and best-model state; do not enter LBFGS or declare completion. A documented review can authorize another 5000-step block without changing this recipe.

lbfgs.stop_rule: Start from the best Adam checkpoint. After at least 40 outer calls, stop only when the running best validation score has gained less than 0.1% cumulatively for 30 calls. At the review boundary, pause with exact current optimizer/model state; do not finalize. A documented review can authorize another 100-call block without changing this recipe.

review_policy: A review boundary is a pause, never a success criterion. Every extension and reason is recorded in the run state and final report. No model is eligible for reserved test/path evaluation until all 15 runs have ended by their validation plateau rules and their final checkpoints are hash-verified. A persistent lack of plateau must be reported honestly, not hidden by an increased budget or a completion label.
